description: Edit company product info, brand context, the default email theme, reply-tracking settings, account-wide sending identity defaults, and defaultSubscriberListIds - which lists new untargeted contacts join. That field is the write path for Dodo Payments and live PostHog events, plus every other integration without per-integration targeting: null = every current and future list (not 'no lists'), [] = no list, [ids] = exactly those lists. PostHog history imports always create contacts without list memberships. fromEmail must use a verified sending domain; replyTo may be any valid mailbox. Missing sender/reply profiles are created automatically. Send fromName/replyToName on their own to rename the display name of the existing default profile without changing its address, or pair them with senderProfileId/replyProfileId (from list_sender_profiles) to rename a specific profile. Provide at least one editable field. Profile, branding, and AI-context fields need the company_profile:manage scope; the sending identity, reply-tracking, and defaultSubscriberListIds fields additionally need companies:manage.

address.description: Physical mailing address for email footers.

brandColors.description: Stored brand color object. Prefer primaryColor for the main color.

companyContext.description: Basic product/company knowledge AI should use when writing emails.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the selected/current company when available.

darkModeLogoUrl.description: Your own dark-mode version of the logo (public PNG, JPG or GIF URL). Every email uses it instead of the automatic outlined copy, light and dark inboxes alike, so it must read on both. Requires a logo; changing the logo later drops it. Pass null to go back to the automatic one. get_company returns it as darkModeLogoUrl with darkModeLogoStatus custom.

defaultSubscriberListIds.description: Which lists new contacts join when something creates a subscriber without explicit list targeting - forms, API writes, events, tag actions, imports, and every integration that does not carry its own targeting. The three states are distinct: null means every current and future list, [] means no list at all, and a populated array means exactly those lists. Repointing this changes only later writes; nobody is moved or removed retroactively. This is the setting that decides where an integration's backfill lands when the provider has no per-integration targeting of its own, so check it with get_company before connecting a store. Unknown list IDs are rejected. In the dashboard it lives under Contacts -> Lists -> Default Lists. Requires the companies:manage scope.

description.description: Short product or company summary for AI writing context.

emailDesignPrompt.description: Art direction for AI-designed emails: layout, density, which sections belong in an email, imagery, CTA prominence, reference brands. Steers design; toneVoice steers copy. Overrides the default composition rules. When empty, the next email generation prefills it with the direction derived from the brand, so read the current value from get_company before editing. Pass an empty string to reset - the next generation refills it.

emailDirection.description: Default email text direction: ltr or rtl.

emailLengthPreference.description: Email length preference: concise, balanced, or detailed. New workspaces default to concise.

emailPreset.description: Default header and footer for new emails: branded adds the logo header and the full footer with social links, minimal uses no logo and a compact footer. Applies to designed, simple text and hand-built emails. Existing emails keep their own setting. While a saved reference email exists (get_email_ai_style), AI-generated emails use its header and footer instead until it is cleared.

emailStylePreference.description: How AI writes emails by default: visual for designed emails with sections and imagery, plain for simple text-focused emails with one button. Both still use the company theme, header and footer. null clears the choice: generation then designs emails and the dashboard asks again. A saved reference email (get_email_ai_style) keeps generated emails designed until it is cleared.

emailTheme.description: Default email theme applied to campaigns, sequences, and transactional email. Partial update: omitted fields keep their current value (or the preset default). Pass null to reset to the platform default theme. Numeric values are clamped to supported ranges. To restyle one sequence email instead, patch that step's emailTheme with update_sequence_node.

buttonStyle.description: How primary buttons are filled: "solid" (default) or "outline" (transparent fill with a brand-color border).

buttonText.description: Label color for solid buttons. Omit to auto-derive a readable color from the button background.

content.description: Inner content card the blocks sit on. Omit to preserve its current value; when no content color is stored, the card follows background.

layout.description: Layout settings. Every field is a number except contentAlign.

contentAlign.description: Where the content column sits in a wide email client: "center" (default) or "left" (flush left, like a plain personal email; buttons, the logo and footers move left too unless set to right, or kept centered with block `styles.keepAlign: true`). Phones show the column full width either way.

presetId.description: Theme preset to base the theme on: default, soft, editorial, or bold.

typography.description: Type settings; numbers except the font-family stacks.

footerFontFamily.description: Footer font stack, also used by the auto-added footer. null removes it.

headingFontFamily.description: Font stack for headings when it differs from the email body font. Omit so headings inherit the email font.

headingFontWeight.description: Heading weight applied to all heading levels, 300-900. Omit for the per-level defaults.

headingLetterSpacing.description: Heading letter spacing in pixels (negative = tighter), clamped to -2..4. Omit for natural tracking.

footerStyle.description: Footer style for new AI-designed emails: classic (brand-colored social icons, centered), mono (monochrome icons, company name as a small wordmark), band (mono on a dark full-width band) or editorial (mono, left-aligned). auto (the default) picks one that fits the brand. Existing emails keep their footers; a footer block's own style field sets one email.

footerTheme.description: Colors and copy of the auto-added footer (appended when an email has no footer block). Merged into the stored theme: omitted fields keep their value, null or an empty string resets one, footerTheme: null resets all. Colors are #rrggbb; empty text uses the localized default. get_company values can be sent back as is. Footer font, size and line height are in emailTheme.typography.

reasonText.description: Why the recipient gets the email.

showCompanyLine.description: Company name above the reason. Default false.

style.description: Same as footerStyle; both with different values is an error.

forwardReplies.description: Enable or disable forwarding captured replies to the configured mailbox.

founderName.description: Founder or sender name for personal email signatures.

fromEmail.description: Set the account-wide default From address. Its domain must already be configured and verified.

fromName.description: Display name of the default From profile. Sent alone it renames the current default profile; with senderProfileId it renames that profile; with fromEmail it names the profile for that address. If the address already has several display names, pass senderProfileId to say which one to rename.

language.description: Primary language code, e.g. en, es, de.

previousCompanyName.description: Required when renameMatchingFooters is true. Current name from get_company; stale names return 409. Retrying a completed rename does not change footers again.

pricing.description: Pricing information used as product context.

primaryColor.description: Primary brand color as a 6-digit hex value, e.g. #f97316.

renameMatchingFooters.description: Optional, default false. With name and previousCompanyName, rename exact matching footer company names in editable emails and saved components. Preserves custom names and protected campaigns. Requires emails:write, templates:write, campaigns:write, sequences:write, transactional:write and ab_tests:write; personal keys require owner/admin access.

replyProfileId.description: Make this existing reply profile the account-wide default, and the one replyToName renames. Get IDs from list_sender_profiles. Mutually exclusive with replyTo.

replyTo.description: Set the account-wide default Reply-To address. Creates a reply profile when needed.

replyToName.description: Display name of the default Reply-To profile. Sent alone it renames the current default profile; with replyProfileId it renames that profile; with replyTo it names the profile for that address.

replyTrackingDomainMode.description: Reply-tracking domain mode: sequenzy always uses Sequenzy's shared reply domain; custom uses the workspace's verified receiving domain for emails from every sending domain, falling back to Sequenzy's domain until one is verified.

replyTrackingEnabled.description: Enable or disable inbound reply capture (Inbox) for this company. Turning it on returns 409 receiving_domain_required when the workspace has no verified receiving domain and has never received a conversation: add one with add_receiving_domain instead, and its first verification turns Inbox on.

senderProfileId.description: Make this existing sender profile the account-wide default, and the one fromName renames. Get IDs from list_sender_profiles. Mutually exclusive with fromEmail.

socialLinks.description: Replacement map of profile URLs keyed by platform. Branded footers show an icon for x (or twitter), threads, bluesky, linkedin, instagram, facebook, youtube, tiktok, pinterest, discord, reddit, and the mobile app store listings appstore and googleplay. Other keys are stored but get no icon.

testimonials.description: Testimonials, usually objects with quote/text and author.

toneVoice.description: Tone of voice guidance for AI-written content.

valueProps.description: Value propositions, usually objects with title and description.

websiteType.description: Company category. It decides which sequence templates are recommended (list_sequence_templates) and steers AI writing; mobile_app turns on push-first mobile journeys and app-aware copy. A value set here is the user's choice and website detection never overwrites it. null clears it so detection may classify the company again. Suggest mobile_app after the user connects RevenueCat, Superwall or Adapty.

name: update_company

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_company` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

company.description: The company record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
